# Modern Git Best Practices Plugin ### Modern Git CLI Ergonomics, Trunk-Based Development & Commit Craftsmanship [![Antigravity Plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/Antigravity-Plugin%20v1.0.0-4F46E5.svg)](https://antigravity.google) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-10B981.svg)](./LICENSE) [![Website](https://img.shields.io/badge/Website-halcyontech.com.br-008080.svg)](https://www.halcyontech.com.br/) [![Organization](https://img.shields.io/badge/Organization-HalcyonTech--LTDA-black.svg)](https://github.com/HalcyonTech-LTDA)

Modern Git engineering best practices, CLI ergonomics (switch, restore, worktree, sparse-checkout), Trunk-Based Development, Conventional & Atomic Commits, interactive rebase, safe force-push (--force-with-lease), conflict resolution (zdiff3, rerere), disaster recovery (reflog, bisect), and SSH/GPG cryptographic signing.

--- ## Installation & Verification ### Antigravity CLI (`agy`) Install directly into your Antigravity environment via the CLI: ```bash agy plugin install https://github.com/HalcyonTech-LTDA/modern-git-best-practices ``` Verify that the plugin is active and adheres to the strict official schema: ```bash agy plugin list agy plugin validate --strict ./modern-git-best-practices ``` --- ## 2. Specialized On-Demand Skills (`skills/`) #### 1. `modern-git-cli-and-workflows` - **Modern Porcelain Tooling**: Replacing `checkout` with `git switch` and `git restore`. Inspection with `git status -sb` and one-line graph logs. - **Branching Strategies**: Transitioning away from legacy GitFlow to Trunk-Based Development (TBD). Standardized branch naming taxonomy (`feat/`, `fix/`, `chore/`, `refactor/`). - **Git Worktrees**: Parallel branch workflows without stashing or cache invalidation (`git worktree add`, `list`, `remove`). Sibling directory conventions. - **Monorepos & Large Repositories**: Blobless clones (`--filter=blob:none`), partial clones, Cone Mode sparse-checkout (`git sparse-checkout set --cone`), and background maintenance. - **Repository Attributes & Hooks**: Deterministic line ending normalization (`* text=auto eol=lf`), binary safety, PR diff collapsing (`linguist-generated`), and `core.hooksPath`. - **Configuration Templates**: Production-ready `.gitconfig` and `.gitattributes` templates. #### 2. `modern-git-commit-craftsmanship` - **Atomic Commits & Bisectability**: Constructing single logical change commits that compile and pass tests at every step of history. - **Conventional Commits v1.0.0**: Comprehensive specification of commit types (`feat`, `fix`, `refactor`, `perf`, `test`, `build`, `ci`, `docs`, `style`, `chore`, `revert`), breaking change indicators (`!`, `BREAKING CHANGE:`), and semantic versioning automation. - **Commit Message Anatomy & 50/72 Rule**: Writing imperative-mood summaries under 50 characters and informative bodies wrapped at 72 characters. - **Interactive Staging & Hygiene**: Precision staging with `git add -p` (hunk splitting, editing), verbose commit review (`git commit -v`). - **Tools & Templates**: Pre-configured commit message template and zero-dependency POSIX `commit-msg` verification hook supporting fixup/squash/amends, merge commits, and nested scopes. #### 3. `modern-git-rebase-and-history` - **Rebase vs. Merge Philosophy**: Strategic trade-offs between linear history and topology preservation. The Golden Rule of Rebasing. - **Interactive Rebase (`git rebase -i`)**: Rewording, squashing, splitting, dropping commits, and testing chains with `--exec`. - **Autosquash & Fixup Workflow**: Streamlining PR review feedback with `git commit --fixup` and `git rebase -i --autosquash`. - **Safe Force-Pushing**: Deep dive into `--force-with-lease` and `--force-if-includes`. Recovery from rejected lease pushes. - **Conflict Resolution**: Upgrading to 3-way `zdiff3` conflict visualization. Automated conflict memory with `git rerere`. #### 4. `modern-git-recovery-and-security` - **Disaster Recovery (`git reflog`)**: Resurrecting hard-reset commits, accidentally deleted branches, and botched rebases. - **Precision Undoing**: Choosing between `git reset` (`--soft`, `--mixed`, `--hard`) and non-destructive `git revert` (including merge commits with `-m 1` and the Linus Torvalds re-merge trap). - **Automated Bug Hunting (`git bisect run`)**: Autonomous binary-search debugging using test scripts to find regressions in O(log N) time. - **Cryptographic Commit Signing**: Modern SSH key signing (`gpg.format ssh`, `id_ed25519`) replacing legacy GPG complexity. Hardware token signing with FIDO2 YubiKeys. - **Secret Sanitization**: Immediate rotation protocol, purge runbooks using `git-filter-repo` (files and regex patterns). - **Maintenance Script**: Automated, worktree-aware, offline-resilient safe branch cleanup script (`git-cleanup-branches.sh`). --- --- ## Quick Reference / Command Cheatsheet ### 1. Modern Porcelain (Replacing Checkout) ```bash # Switch to existing branch git switch # Create and switch to new branch git switch -c # Discard uncommitted changes in working tree git restore # Unstage a file without losing modifications git restore --staged # Restore file from another branch or commit git restore --source= ``` ### 2. Worktrees (Zero-Stash Multi-Tasking) ```bash # Spawn worktree for urgent hotfix git worktree add -b fix/p1-bug ../repo-hotfix origin/main # List active worktrees git worktree list # Clean up worktree after merge git worktree remove ../repo-hotfix ``` ### 3. Precision Staging & Commits ```bash # Interactively stage hunks git add -p # Commit with full diff review in editor git commit -v # Target commit for automatic PR review fixup git commit --fixup ``` ### 4. Interactive Rebase & History Polishing ```bash # Rebase with automated fixup folding git rebase -i --autosquash origin/main # Validate every commit compiles during rebase git rebase -i --exec "./gradlew test" origin/main # Safe force push (mandatory) git push --force-with-lease --force-if-includes ``` ### 5. Recovery & Automated Bisect ```bash # Inspect movement audit trail git reflog -n 10 # Resurrect deleted branch at commit git switch -c # Autonomous binary-search regression hunting git bisect start HEAD v1.0.0 git bisect run ./test-script.sh git bisect reset ``` --- --- ## What's Included (Component Catalog) ### Contextual Rules (`rules/`) Automatically loaded to govern and protect project contexts: - **[`modern-git-engineering.md`](rules/modern-git-engineering.md)**: Automatically enforces modern Git engineering standards, CLI ergonomics (switch, restore, worktree, sparse-checkout), Trunk-Based Development, Conventional & Atomic Commits, rebase discipline, safe force-push (--force-with-lease), conflict resolution (zdiff3, rerere), disaster recovery (reflog, bisect), and cryptographic signing. ### Procedural Skills (`skills/`) On-demand actionable workflows and runbooks: - **[`/modern-git-cli-and-workflows`](skills/modern-git-cli-and-workflows/SKILL.md)**: Use this skill when interacting with the Git CLI, navigating branches, discarding or unstaging files, structuring branching strategies (Trunk-Based Development), setting up git worktrees for parallel branch work, configuring sparse-checkouts or partial clones for monorepos, and establishing modern global Git configuration defaults. - **[`/modern-git-commit-craftsmanship`](skills/modern-git-commit-craftsmanship/SKILL.md)**: Use this skill when preparing, structuring, and authoring Git commits, enforcing Conventional Commits v1.0.0, crafting atomic and bisectable commits, performing patch-level interactive staging (git add -p), and formulating high-signal commit messages (50/72 rule). - **[`/modern-git-rebase-and-history`](skills/modern-git-rebase-and-history/SKILL.md)**: Use this skill when managing branch integration (rebase vs merge), rewriting local commit history, executing interactive rebases (git rebase -i), utilizing autosquash and fixup workflows, safely force-pushing with lease (--force-with-lease), and resolving conflicts using modern 3-way tools and rerere. - **[`/modern-git-recovery-and-security`](skills/modern-git-recovery-and-security/SKILL.md)**: Use this skill when recovering lost commits or deleted branches using git reflog, conducting automated binary-search debugging with git bisect, executing non-destructive production rollbacks (git revert), configuring SSH or GPG cryptographic commit signing, and sanitizing leaked secrets with git-filter-repo. --- ## Directory Hierarchy ```text modern-git-best-practices/ ├── plugin.json # Official Antigravity manifest (schema v1) ├── LICENSE # MIT License (Copyright 2026 HalcyonTech LTDA) ├── .gitignore # System ignores & installed_version.json exclusions ├── .gitattributes # Deterministic line endings (* text=auto eol=lf) ├── README.md # Golden Standard documentation & runbook ├── assets/ │ ├── logo.svg # Antigravity marketplace square icon │ └── halcyon-horizontal-cor.svg # Official Halcyon Tech brand logo (white background) # Official Halcyon Tech corporate vector symbol ├── rules/ # Contextual rules discovered automatically │ └── modern-git-engineering.md ├── skills/ # Actionable procedural skills (Progressive Disclosure) │ └── modern-git-cli-and-workflows/ │ └── SKILL.md │ └── modern-git-commit-craftsmanship/ │ └── SKILL.md │ └── modern-git-rebase-and-history/ │ └── SKILL.md │ └── modern-git-recovery-and-security/ │ └── SKILL.md ``` --- ## 💡 Prompt Recipes & Use Cases ```markdown -
